title: gate sprint-complete closes a sprint with its required retro missing
detail: Observed closing deviation-names-one-file: integrating lists design/{feature}/retro.md as a required exit artifact, the Write of it was refused in reviewing, and gate sprint-complete then ran and returned rc 0 with no retro on disk. Only the Stop hook reports exit artifacts, so a command run in the same turn as the advance skips them. Check the current phase's exit artifacts in sprint-complete, as advance does, and fail closed.
